versionGroups.label: Peer ranges declare what a consumer may provide, not what this repo installs, so they are not pinned like dependencies. `pnpm peers check` (run by deps:check) proves every peer range accepts the version the workspace actually installs.

One @types/pg for the whole tree: pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides it to this exact version (the adapter's and the app's `Pool` must be the same declarations), so every workspace declares that exact version too. Bump the override and these together.
apps/mobile + packages/ui-native: React Native and its @react-native/* tooling are the version Expo SDK 58 pins (0.88)
apps/mobile + packages/ui-native: Metro is the version @expo/metro bundles for SDK 58, so Uniwind's Metro peers resolve to the bundler Expo runs
apps/mobile + packages/ui-native: jest-expo 58 runs on Jest 30 (ADR 031)
apps/mobile + packages/ui-native: Jest's types follow the Jest that jest-expo 58 runs

apps/docs: `astro check` runs on Volar, which needs the TypeScript JS API that TypeScript 7 no longer ships (@astrojs/check 0.9.12 peers ^5 || ^6). Remove once an @astrojs/check release supports TypeScript 7.
Shared deps must be the same version across all workspaces

semverGroups.label: Shared deps are pinned to exact versions (no ^ or ~)
